messages:
jen: FYI deploybot blocked RC-2026.03 on SBOM attestation — missing cosign signature for base image. release notes are blocked. Can we timebox evidence or pin to 2026.02 base?

deploybot: [deploybot] Release rc-2026.03 -> SBOM_SIG_CHECK FAILED for image redwood/runtime:2026.03. Missing attestation: cosign signed=false. Build: https://ci.internal/redwood/4567

mike: @devsec @legal quick decision? Policy requires attestation or an exception. If legal ok we can pin to last signed digest and limit to a canary.

devsec: We can do an "expedited-evidence" window per policy — 4 hours max. Need either cosign attestation proof or the GCR manifest showing the signature metadata. Otherwise we should roll back or pin.

legal: Need a risk ack if bypassing. If the image is our infra image and no 3p code changed, we can approve a conditional canary (EU-only) with a formal ticket and 1-week remediation followup.

jen: OK starting evidence window now. I'll ping build + infra to fetch cosign output. If nothing in 4h we'll pin to digest redwood/runtime@sha256:abcd1234 for canary and delay global rollout.

sre_oncall: If we pin, ensure release agents update routing and prometheus labels. I'll create a canary rollback job in case metrics spike. Also add temporary alert thresholds.

mike: Procedural: update release notes with "limited canary due to SBOM attestation delay" and link ticket INF-7890.

jen: Copying logs/commands I'm running to fetch evidence:
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/foo redwood/runtime:2026.03
gcloud container images describe redwood/runtime:2026.03 --format=json > manifest.json
```

devsec: If cosign returns "no attestation" ask build to re-run signing step — sometimes the upload to storage fails. I'm opening a short runbook and will join the build channel.

deploybot: [deploybot] Action required — manual approval requested by @legal to continue without full attestation. Approve with: `/deploy approve --ticket INF-7890 --scope canary`

jen: I'll run the collection now and post results here. If legal OKs the conditional canary, proceed. :thumbsup:
